name: 15 Sai Datta
source:
Boy and girl get acquainted via a dating site. They quickly get attracted to each other, but boy's life expectancy turns out to be very short due to strange disease changing him before her very eyes. Death and love compete with each other. And only one person knows the truth...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
